literal_meaning: নাক (nose) + আল (leading or path, implying being led by the nose or troubled path)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কাজে আমাকে নাকাল করে দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I've become exhausted from the long journey.
This work has left me completely harassed.
note: Often used in contexts of physical or mental fatigue from efforts or adversities in Bengali folklore and everyday speech.
